title: 24-transition atlas
what_it_does: 24 transitions in six families (cut, carry, camera, mask, material, time) with what it is, when to use, when to avoid, energy level and tones, as data plus a browsable page.
when_to_use: Picking a transition on purpose instead of defaulting to a fade.
why: MIT (verified LICENSE; API shows NOASSERTION only because of a font note). Pure prose and JSON, so it is cheap and safe to ship.
